title: Best clarinetist in town after Bechet
summary: Who was considered best clarinetist; Handy came after Bechet left, then switched to alto and George Lewis rose.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Did they have one guy who would be acclaimed, the best clarinet player in town, be chosen at any time?
Yeah. He's an ambition. He was considered by who to be the best? Everybody. Everybody. Musicians? Listeners? Everybody.
Everybody considered him to be the best.

And then after he left? Then I come in the picture. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. And, uh, how long did you stay, well, what did they call the guy who was the best clarinet player? Did he have a special name? No, nothing. Like, a clarinet king or anything like that?
No, just called him by his regular name.
Yeah. I thought maybe they gave him a title. No. Like, kid or king or something, you know?
No. They called him by his regular name. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
And so, uh, you came in the picture after Bechet.
And then you put the clarinet down, huh?
I put it down for Alto Satchipa. Mm-hmm.
And who took up on clarinet after that? Who would you say? Well, I'm not. Oh, but any, was anybody on clarinet?
Yeah, George Lewis. You'd say he was the king?
Yeah, he was, he was about to next to me. He was George Lewis. When did George Lewis start coming in the public eye, would you say?
